name: _legal.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  internals/_legal.scss — the legal-page container: %MAXAREA with the
//  horizontal padding zeroed so the grid indent comes entirely from
//  .internal-description's own 25% padding (cols 4–9).
//  Imported by internals.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Legal page container ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Needs %MAXAREA for width:100% + position:relative + box-sizing on the host.
// BUT horizontal padding is reset to 0 at all breakpoints so the grid indent
// comes entirely from .internal-description's own 25% padding (cols 4–9).
.legal {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  box-sizing: border-box;
  // Reset all MAXAREA horizontal padding — .internal-description provides
  // the 12.5% / 25% column-indent itself, so no outer indent is needed here.
  padding-left: 0;
  padding-right: 0;

  @include layout-320() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
  @include layout-375() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
  @include layout-414() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
  @include layout-540() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
  @include layout-768() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
  @include layout-960() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
  @include layout-1024() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
  @include layout-1280() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
  @include layout-1440() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
  @include layout-1680() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
  @include layout-1920() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
  @include layout-2560() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
}
